objective: Combine deterministic and semantic retrieval while preserving source-of-truth discipline: deterministic results are authoritative; semantic results are advisory, source-linked suggestions that never assemble a final answer (that stays in the Research Packet / Evaluation layers).

summary.migrator_change: None — V38 already created hybrid_query_runs + hybrid_query_results; schema stays 38, contract table count stays 190.

entry_points: build_hybrid_retrieval(query, *, db_path=None, project_key=None, families=None, mode='hybrid', embed_model=None, top_k=None, persist_root=None) -> dict
hybrid_broker.semantic_path: Loads the latest applied SimpleVectorStore from disk (StorageContext.from_defaults + load_index_from_storage + as_retriever.retrieve), embedding the query with the configured local model. Injectable embed_model (default HuggingFace bge-small; proofs/tests inject MockEmbedding). Each match is source-linked to a vector_index_items receipt, floored at review tier 2 (never auto-tier-1), and re-validated with the Prompt 14 no-raw guardrail before admission.
hybrid_broker.merge: Deterministic items first (authoritative), then non-duplicate advisory semantic items; re-bounded with apply_context_budget(load_context_budget()).
hybrid_broker.fail_closed: Semantic path skipped (deterministic still returned) when SDK absent (semantic_sdk_not_available), no applied index (semantic_no_applied_index), or deterministic-only mode (semantic_disabled_mode). The whole surface is V38-gated (HybridRetrievalError on stale schema / missing policy).
hybrid_broker.read_only: build_hybrid_retrieval and the `hybrid search` CLI persist nothing to the operator DB; the raw query is never persisted (only its hash); the receipt path is exercised in the proof.

source_of_truth_discipline.no_mcp_exposure: Vector/semantic search is not registered as an MCP tool (no-raw-access contract honored).
